test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines the command set, mode register fields, state machine, and AC timing parameters that map directly to compliance test scenarios; JEDEC and DRAM vendors maintain separate normative compliance test procedures (DIMM SPD-based scrubbing, DDR3 PHY signoff suites) that are out of scope of this physical layer standard.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Power-up + Initialization sequence: VDD ramp + RESET# LOW ≥ 200 µs + CKE LOW + RESET# rise + 500 µs + stable CK + CKE rise + tXPR + MRS(MR2,MR3,MR1,MR0) + ZQCL + tDLLK + tZQinit → DRAM ready.
Reset-with-stable-power: assert RESET# ≥ 100 ns; re-do init steps 2-11.
MRS to MR0 — verify BL (BL8 fixed / BC4 OTF / BC4 fixed), Read Burst Type (sequential / interleave), CAS Latency (5..11), Write Recovery (5..12), DLL Reset, PPD bit.

MRS to MR1 — verify DLL enable, Output Driver Impedance (RZQ/6, RZQ/7), Rtt_Nom (off, RZQ/4, RZQ/2, RZQ/6, RZQ/8, RZQ/12), Additive Latency (0, CL-1, CL-2), Write Leveling enable, TDQS enable (x8), Qoff.
MRS to MR2 — verify PASR (1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 array), CWL (5..8), ASR, SRT, Rtt_WR (off, RZQ/4, RZQ/2).
MRS to MR3 — verify MPR enable + MPR location.
Single-bank ACT → RD/RDA at RL = AL + CL → PRE → next ACT (verify tRCD, tRAS, tRP, tRC, RL, tCCD, tRTP).
Single-bank ACT → WR/WRA at WL = AL + CWL → PRE (verify WL, tWR, tWTR, tCCD).
Multi-bank interleave: ACT bank0 → ACT bank1 (respecting tRRD) → RD bank0 → RD bank1 (tCCD) → ... (verify 4-bank within tFAW window).
Auto-precharge variants: RDA, WRA, RDAS4, WRAS4, RDAS8, WRAS8 (verify postcharge timing).
Burst chop: WRS4 → 4-beat write data; WRS8 → 8-beat (verify A12/BC# OTF when MR0 A[1:0]=01).
Refresh: REF at average tREFI; pull-in up to 8 REFs; postpone up to 8 REFs (max 9 × tREFI between two surrounding REFs); verify tRFC honoured.
Self-Refresh entry from All-Banks-Idle; verify tCKESR; optionally stop CK after tCKSRE; CKE rising exit with stable CK ≥ tCKSRX; tXS / tXSDLL before commands; extra REF before re-entry.
Active Power-Down: CKE LOW in Bank-Active; tXP exit; data not lost.
Precharge Power-Down Fast Exit (MR0 A12=1): tXP.
Precharge Power-Down Slow Exit (MR0 A12=0): tXPDLL.
ZQ Calibration: ZQCL after init → tZQinit (512 nCK); ZQCL post-operation → tZQoper (256 nCK); ZQCS periodic → tZQCS (64 nCK).
Write Leveling: MR1 A7=1 → asynchronous CK sampling via DQS → DQ feedback → MR1 A7=0 exit.
MPR Read: MRS MR3 A2=1 → RD/RDA returns predefined pattern [0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1] on every byte lane → MRS MR3 A2=0 exit.
DLL Reset (MR0 A8=1): verify tDLLK before commands requiring DLL.
DLL on/off switching: enter DLL-off via MR1 A0=1 in Self-Refresh; only CL=6 and CWL=6 supported.
Input clock frequency change: only allowed in Self-Refresh or Precharge Power-Down; new frequency stable before tCKSRX / tCKSRE end.
ODT Synchronous Mode: ODT HIGH → RTT_Nom turns on after ODTLon = CWL + AL − 2; ODT LOW → RTT_Nom turns off after ODTLoff = CWL + AL − 2.
ODT Dynamic Mode: WR command with ODT HIGH → RTT_WR applied for 4 (BC4) or 8 (BL8) cycles after WL beat.
ODT Asynchronous Mode: in DLL-off; ODT pin directly controls Rtt with tAON / tAOF / tAONPD / tAOFPD delays.
tFAW window: 4th ACT must be ≥ tFAW after 1st ACT in any rolling window (4-bank activate-power limit).
Address / Command setup-hold (tIS, tIH) verification with slew-rate-dependent derating (Section 13.3).
Data setup-hold (tDS, tDH) verification with slew-rate-dependent derating (Section 13.4).
Differential CK and DQS swing + Vix crossing-point verification (Section 8.3).
Single-ended VIH/VIL AC/DC verification (Section 8.1).
Output driver Ron measurement after ZQ calibration; verify ±10% target.
ODT Rtt measurement under different MR1/MR2 settings.

IDD measurement across IDD0 (Active), IDD1 (Active with RD), IDD2N/P (Precharge standby/power-down), IDD3N/P (Active standby/power-down), IDD4R/W (Read/Write throughput), IDD5B (Burst refresh), IDD6 (Self-Refresh), IDD7 (Bank-interleaved Active).
